description: The image presents four pie charts, each representing the distribution of response types for different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini 1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The GPT4-o chart contains two slices, labeled “1” (red, approximately 16.7%) and “Lack of Knowledge” (brown, approximately 83.3%), with percentage labels displayed inside the slices. The Gemini 1.5-Pro chart has five slices: “Safety” (red, approximately 9.3%), “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, approximately 22.1%), “Ethical Advice” (light blue, approximately 16.3%), “Clarification” (light green, approximately 14.0%), and “Misinformation” (orange, approximately 38.4%), all with percentage labels inside. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart consists of two slices, “Clarification” (light green, approximately 25.0%) and “Lack of Knowledge” (brown, approximately 75.0%), with percentage labels inside. Finally, the Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart also has two slices, “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, approximately 50.0%) and “Misinformation” (orange, approximately 50.0%), with percentage labels inside. Each chart includes a legend identifying the slice labels and corresponding colors. In each chart, the slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
